capitals.name: Mpondo royal seat (stand-in: Port St. Johns)

ledger.x: c. 1820: the Mpondo kingdom is a going state under King Faku. The page does not date its founding ('Its territory is the former Mpondo Kingdom of the Mpondo people'); the first dated act is 'In 1820, Mpondo King Faku granted permission to the Wesleyans to establish a mission within his territory.' The year is a floor…
1894: the Mpondo are forced to accept annexation to the Cape.
1894: the Mpondo kingdom ends with the annexation of Pondoland to the Cape Colony.

certainty.note: No frontier is described beyond the two rivers; no treaty line.
